c.brief: The hosted stage's numbers, as the OMX_HOSTED_STAGE_ names a host reads.

HOSTED_STAGE_LIMITS.doc: The numbers a hosted plugin's stage limits itself to: the warm-up before it is published, the blocks of non-finite output that strike it, the level its output is clamped at, the parameter queue and the events one block delivers, the polls and timeouts of the hand-over between threads, the ports the core accepts and the caps on a plugin's state, log and parameter count. These are the stage's safety numbers, not an operator's travel.

docs.warmupLevelDbfs: the level of the warm-up signal, in dBFS
docs.nonFiniteStrikes: the blocks of non-finite output that strike a stage
docs.clampDbfs: the level the output is clamped at, in dBFS
docs.paramQueueDepth: the records the parameter queue holds
docs.eventsPerBlock: the parameter events delivered in one block
docs.unpublishPollUs: the poll interval while an unpublish waits for the audio thread, in microseconds
docs.unpublishTimeoutUs: the longest an unpublish waits for the audio thread, in microseconds
docs.workerPollUs: how often an LV2 instance's worker thread polls its request ring, in microseconds
docs.workerRingBytes: the bytes of each of an LV2 instance's two worker rings; a power of two, 16 or more
docs.notesPerBlock: the note events delivered in one block
docs.mainPortChannels: the channels the main port is limited to
docs.auxOutputs: the auxiliary output ports the core accepts
docs.auxInputs: the auxiliary input ports (side chains) the core accepts
docs.stateMaxBytes: the largest plugin state the core saves or loads, in bytes
docs.logBytes: the size of a plugin log message, in bytes
docs.rolePollUs: the poll interval while the audio role is taken, in microseconds
docs.roleTimeoutUs: the longest the audio role is waited for, in microseconds
docs.paramCountMax: the widest parameter count the core trusts
docs.latencyHoldMs: the hold before a hosted stage's new latency takes effect, in milliseconds

HOSTING_CODES.doc: The refusals the CLAP core returns, by the hosting code a verdict names them by. A code is never reworded.

notAudioEffect.doc: the plugin is not an audio effect

noteInput.doc: the plugin declares a note input the configuration refuses

noAudioInput.doc: the plugin has no audio input

noAudioOutput.doc: the plugin has no audio output

widerThanStrip.doc: the plugin is wider than the strip

extraInputs.doc: the plugin has extra inputs, fed silence

crashedLive.doc: the plugin crashed live on this rig
